# Start Forcing Player Position

Source: [4449](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4449); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Start Forcing Player Position](../../api/actions/start-forcing-player-position.md).

<a id="wiki-4449-n1"></a>

- Forcing position can reevaluate position every frame, but never reevaluates the Player input; with reevaluation false it samples position once.
